flags.TEXT_SKIP_DISABLED.description: Volatile. Prevents you from skipping text in some cutscenes.
flags.DARK_WORLD_MENU_DISABLED.descripti: Prevents you from opening the Dark World menu and affects music when leaving shops.
flags.SIMPLIFIED_VFX_ENABLED.description: Set from the Dark World menu.
flags.BATTLE_MUSIC_STATE.description: Volatile. Allows or prevents the game from playing Rude Buster at the start of an encounter.
flags.WRIST_PROTECTOR_ENABLED.descriptio: Whether you have the Wrist Protector. Enabled by default since the Chapter 1&2 release.
flags.SCREEN_SHAKE_DISABLED.description: Keeps the game screen from shaking. Intended to be set from the Dark World menu.
flags.OLD_ATTACK_CONTROLS_ENABLED.descri: Use Z, X, and C, not just Z, to time attacks.
flags.BATTLE_MENU_SELECTION_REMEMBERED.d: Prevents the game from resetting your selection to 'FIGHT' each turn.
flags.OTHER_TEXT_COMMAND.description: Volatile. Controls how some characters' overworld sprites interact with their dialogue, among other things.
flags.DOOR_FREEZE_TIMER.description: Volatile. Controls timing of room fades.
flags.X_SLOWING_DISABLED.description: Added in 1.08. Pressing Z while holding C in combat toggles it. Becomes debug-only in 1.09.
flags.CAN_CLIMB.description: Whether you can climb walls using the Claimb Claws.
flags.OBTAINED_PETAL_FEATHER.description: Whether you can enter platformer mode with Mysterious Statues using the Petal Feather.
flags.SUSIE_SHOW_EYES.description: Makes Susie show her eyes at the end of Chapter 1. Ignored in Chapter 2; she shows her eyes anyway.
flags.RALSEI_HAT_STATE.description: Controls Ralsei's face selection. Ignored in Chapter 2; he's hatless anyway.
flags.LOUD_STEPS_DISABLED.description: Stops the echoing step sound found in the ?????? area, Great Door field, and Jevil's room.
flags.EQUIP_COMMENTS_HIDDEN.description: Prevents Susie and Ralsei from commenting on items you give them when in room_man.
flags.CHOICE_TIME_TAKEN.description: Volatile. The time, in frames, you take to make a choice. Used by Sans.
flags.PARTY_ACTS_DISABLED.description: Initialized to 1, reset to 0 when unlocking S-Action and R-Action.
flags.GAME_OVER_MODE.description: Controls what the game does on game over. Usually 0.
flags.DOJO_FAILURE.description: Set when losing Party Dojo battles (i.e. when flag 35 is 1). Affects prize and dialogue.
flags.DOJO_ACTIVE.description: Alters battle win text and prevents you from gaining money outside of prizes.
flags.BATTLE_END_MESSAGE_DISABLED.descri: Disables the battle end message. Used for SnowGraving Berdly and Party Dojo.
flags.DOJO_BATTLE_ABORTED.description: Something to do with immediately ending Party Dojo battles, also used in the Jackenstein fight.
flags.VIOLENCE_COUNT.description: Total number of enemies defeated through FIGHTing. Can be reduced by obtaining forgiveness from Rudinn or Hathy.
flags.SPARE_COUNT.description: Total number of enemies SPAREd. Unaccessed.
flags.PACIFY_COUNT.description: Total number of enemies Pacify/Sleep Mist-ed. Unaccessed.
Violences committed by Susie while not under player control. In SURVEY_PROGRAM and Chapter 1&2 it's never set due to a bug. It is possible to get the Chapter 1 Overthrow ending even if this is 1.
flags.KILL_COUNT.description: Total number of enemies you killed. Includes SnowGrave and killing Pipis.
flags.FREEZE_COUNT.description: Total number of enemies you froze.
flags.LAST_ENCOUNTER_TP.description: Amount of TP gained in last encounter, used for Tenna's scoring system.
flags.LAST_ENCOUNTER_OUTCOME.description: Volatile. Contains what you did in the last encounter. For multiple enemies, priority is Violence > Spare > Pacify > IceShock.
flags.LAST_ENEMY_1_OUTCOME.description: Volatile. What you did to the top monster in the last encounter.
flags.LAST_ENEMY_2_OUTCOME.description: Volatile. What you did to the middle monster in the last encounter.
flags.LAST_ENEMY_3_OUTCOME.description: Volatile. What you did to the bottom monster in the last encounter.
flags.ENCOUNTER_RESULT_FLAG_ID.descripti: Volatile. Contains a numerical value representing the current encounter, which is used to permanently store the outcome of that encounter in a flag.
flags.FROZEN_ENEMY_X.description: Volatile. Used to return enemies to the correct spot in the overworld when frozen.
flags.FROZEN_ENEMY_Y.description: Volatile. Used to return enemies to the correct spot in the overworld when frozen.
flags.DOJO_NEXT_ENCOUNTER.description: Volatile. Used to chain encounters for the Party Dojo All Stars challenge.
flags.RECRUITING_DISABLED.description: Prevents you from recruiting enemies in Party Dojo battles.
flags.NON_NARRATIVE_BATTLE_INTRO.descrip: Used when Noelle enters her first battle and when Susie wants to demonstrate UltimateHeal to not use the normal battle introduction typer.
flags.LAST_ENEMY_WAS_VIOLENCED.descripti: Volatile. Triggers 'You/Noelle became stronger' when violencing enemies.
flags.STORAGE_CAPACITY.description: The amount of items you can keep in your pockets. Always 24 in Chapters 2 and 3, 36 in Chapter 4, code exists to set it to 48 in Chapter 6 and later.
flags.LEVEL_UP_COUNT_CH2.description: The number of times you have leveled up by violently defeating an encounter. Used for certain increases that only occur every 2, 4, or 10 encounters.
flags.AT_MAGIC_GAIN_COUNT_CH2.descriptio: The number of times your AT and Magic have increased due to leveling up (every ten encounters). Used to prevent overly increasing them when sealing the fountain.
flags.OBTAINED_GLOWSHARD.description: Whether you obtained the Glowshard. Prevents it from re-appearing.
flags.DARK_CANDY_TREE_1_TAKEN.descriptio: How much Dark Candy you've taken from the first Dark Candy tree.
flags.DARK_CANDY_TREE_2_TAKEN.descriptio: How much Dark Candy you've taken from the second Dark Candy tree.
flags.OBTAINED_BROKEN_CAKE_PIECE.descrip: Whether you took a piece of the Broken Cake.
flags.OBTAINED_WHITE_RIBBON.description: Whether you got the White Ribbon.
flags.OBTAINED_IRON_SHACKLE.description: Whether you took the Iron Shackle.
flags.ATE_MOSS_CH1.description: Whether you ate the moss in Chapter 1. Allows you to obtain the Moss Finder title.
flags.OBTAINED_DANCER_REVIVE_MINT.descri: Whether you got the Revive Mint from the Scissor Dancers room.
flags.OBTAINED_RAGGER.description: Whether you got the Ragger. Affects the Royal Coat Rack's dialogue about it.
flags.OBTAINED_DICE_BRACE.description: Whether you got the Dice Brace.
flags.OBTAINED_BLOXER_ROOM_MONEY.descrip: Whether you got the 40D$ from that room with Bloxers.
flags.UNUSED_BLOXER_ROOM_REVIVE_MINT.des: Whether you got a Revive Mint from that room with Bloxers. Unused because there isn't actually a Revive Mint chest in that room.
flags.OBTAINED_JEVIL_REWARD.description: Whether you got the Jevilstail/Devilsknife from a chest. It appears outside the room if your inventory is full after the battle.
flags.OBTAINED_CLUBS_SANDWICH.descriptio: Whether you got the Clubs Sandwich.
flags.OBTAINED_CASTLE_REVIVE_MINT.displa: Got the Card Castle Revive Mint
flags.OBTAINED_CASTLE_REVIVE_MINT.descri: Whether you got the Revive Mint from that chest that appears when you interact with the portraits.
flags.OBTAINED_BROKEN_KEY_A.description: Whether you got the Broken Key A. Also set if you defeat the Knight in Chapter 3 due to an encounterflag reuse.
flags.OBTAINED_BROKEN_KEY_B.description: Whether you got the Broken Key B.
flags.OBTAINED_BROKEN_KEY_C.description: Whether you got the Broken Key C.
flags.OBTAINED_FIRST_GLOW_WRIST.descript: Whether you got the first Glow Wrist.
flags.OBTAINED_NUBERT_TREASURE.descripti: Whether you got the Fiber Scarf.
flags.OBTAINED_SECOND_GLOW_WRIST.descrip: Whether you got that other Glow Wrist.
flags.TENNA_ENCOUNTER_OUTCOME.descriptio: Tracks the state of the Tenna battle.
flags.OBTAINED_TENSION_BIT.description: Whether you got the Tension Bit.
flags.OBTAINED_THIRD_REVIVE_MINT_CH2.des: Whether you got the THIRD Revive Mint.
flags.UNUSED_REVIVE_DUST_FLAG.descriptio: Unused. Intended for obtaining the Revive Dust, but overwritten by 137.
flags.OBTAINED_TRASH_CAN_20_DOLLARS.desc: Whether you got 20D$ from the twenty-dollar trash can.
flags.OBTAINED_TRASH_CAN_80_DOLLARS.desc: Whether you got 80D$ from the eighty-dollar trash can.
flags.OBTAINED_TRASH_CAN_CD_BAGEL.displa: Got a CD Bagel from the trash can
flags.OBTAINED_TRASH_CAN_CD_BAGEL.descri: Whether you got a CD Bagel from the CD Bagel trash can.
flags.OBTAINED_BOUNCE_BLADE.description: Whether you got the Bounce Blade.
flags.OBTAINED_SECOND_TRASH_CAN_20_DOLLA: Whether you got 20D$ from the other twenty-dollar trash can.
flags.OBTAINED_SECOND_TRASH_CAN_CD_BAGEL: Got the second trash-can CD Bagel
Whether you got a CD Bagel from the other CD Bagel trash can.
flags.OBTAINED_ONE_DOLLAR_CHEST.descript: Whether you got the $1 from the one-dollar treasure chest.
flags.OBTAINED_PINK_RIBBON.description: Whether you got the Pink Ribbon.
flags.OBTAINED_CD_BAGEL_CHEST.descriptio: Whether you got a CD Bagel from the CD Bagel treasure chest.
flags.OBTAINED_SECRET_DARK_CANDY.descrip: Whether you got a Dark Candy from the secret Dark Candy location.
flags.OBTAINED_REVIVE_DUST.description: Whether you got the Revive Dust.
flags.OBTAINED_FOURTH_REVIVE_MINT.descri: Whether you got the fourth Revive Mint from a painting.
flags.OBTAINED_MANSION_GLOWSHARD.descrip: Whether you got the Glowshard in Queen's Mansion, found by activating all the platters behind the door on the 2F moving vases room.
flags.OBTAINED_TRASH_CAN_DARK_CANDY.disp: Got Dark Candy from the trash can
flags.OBTAINED_TRASH_CAN_DARK_CANDY.desc: Whether you got a Dark Candy from the Dark Candy trash can.
flags.OBTAINED_CHAIN_MAIL.description: Whether you got the Chain Mail armor.
flags.OBTAINED_SPAMTON_REWARD.descriptio: Whether you got the Dealmaker/Puppet Scarf from a chest. There's one immediately after you beat Spamton, and one back at My Castle Town.
flags.SOUND_OF_JUSTICE_SUSIE_ENCOUNTER_O: Tracks the state of the Susie-only stage of the Sound of Justice Battle, always 2.
flags.TITAN_SPAWN_ENCOUNTER_OUTCOME.desc: Tracks the state of the Titan Spawn encounter.
flags.SOUND_OF_JUSTICE_KRIS_ENCOUNTER_OU: Tracks the state of the Kris stage of the Sound of Justice Battle, always 2.
flags.RAN_IN_SCHOOL.description: Whether you ran to Susie in the Chapter 1 school scene. Unaccessed.
flags.SOLVED_EYE_PUZZLE.description: Whether you solved the eye puzzle in the ?????? area.
flags.DARK_AREA_MOVEMENT_CHOICE.descript: How you proceeded once finding Susie in the ?????? area.
flags.SKIPPED_PROPHECY.description: Whether you skipped Ralsei's prophecy. Lancer explains it instead.
flags.RALSEI_SUBJECT_RESPONSE.descriptio: How you answered Ralsei when he said he had no subjects... that is, unused.
flags.RALSEI_TUTORIAL_OUTCOME.map.2: Hug Ralsei (in unused version of tutorial)
flags.LEARNED_TO_RUN.description: Set to 1 whether Ralsei explains it or you demonstrate. Just prevents him from asking again.
flags.MANUAL_DISPOSAL_PROGRESS.descripti: Your progress on being a terrible person. Ralsei gives you a trash can for the manual instead of a stand, in case you ever want to trash it again.
flags.RE_CONVINCED_RUDINN.description: Whether you Convinced Rudinn after failing to do. Unused, since it works first try now.
flags.SAW_FIELD_SONG.description: Prevents you from seeing the Field of Hopes and Dreams title every single room.
flags.LANCER_PRE_HATHY_DIALOGUE.descript: Alters Lancer's dialogue if interacted with prior to the triple Hathy fight.
flags.C_ROUND_OUTCOME.description: What happened to C. Round. Can skip Ralsei telling Susie not to fight.
flags.VANDALIZED_BOX_PUZZLE_STATE.descri: Progress on the vandalized box puzzle.
flags.TALKED_TO_JIGSAW_JOE.description: Whether you talked to Joe (and were inevitably offered a tutorial). Makes him help with the Warp Door.
flags.DONATED_TO_HOLE.description: Whether you put a dollar in the donation hole.
flags.SOLVED_FIRST_ROUXLS_PUZZLE.descrip: Whether you solved Rouxls's first puzzle.
flags.SOLVED_SECOND_ROUXLS_PUZZLE.descri: Whether you solved Rouxls's second puzzle.
flags.THRASH_MACHINE_SHOE.description: Your Thrash Machine's... well, there's a lot of variance here.
flags.MADE_THRASH_MACHINE.description: Whether you designed the Thrash Machine yet.
flags.LANCER_FOLLOW_DIALOGUE_PROGRESS.de: How far Lancer has followed you after joining the team.
flags.LANCER_FOLLOW_DIALOGUE_PROGRESS.ma: All we gotta do is crush them.
flags.JAIL_INTERACTION_COUNT.description: The number of times you have interacted with objects while in jail. The cutscene is triggered by talking to Ralsei after 3+ interactions.
flags.INTERACTED_WITH_SALSA.description: Whether you interacted with the salsa stump. NOT what you actually did; that isn't saved.
Asked the Royal Coat Rack about the chest
Whether you talked to the Royal Coat Rack before taking the Ragger. Changes their dialogue if you take it without asking.
flags.SOLVED_CLOVER_PUZZLE.description: Whether you solved the suits puzzle before the Clover fight.
Unused barrier flag for the suits puzzle before the Clover fight.
flags.TALKED_TO_ALL_CLOVER_HEADS.descrip: Set when talking to all of Clover before her fight. Alters her dialogue.
flags.SOLVED_DARK_PUZZLE.description: Whether you solved the puzzle in the darknening room. It does not save if you did it without going in the middle.
flags.SUSIE_BOUGHT_SNACK.description: Whether Susie and Lancer bought their Hearts Donut yet.
flags.CARD_CASTLE_ELEVATOR_FLOOR.descrip: Volatile. Tracks the floor you're currently on when in elevators.
flags.CARD_CASTLE_ELEVATOR_UNLOCKED.desc: Whether you have unlocked the Card Castle elevator by going to floor 5F.
flags.JEVIL_PROGRESS.description: Your progress with JEVIL. Alters Seam's dialogue.
flags.JEVIL_REWARD_CHEST_ITEM.descriptio: The item in the chest outside JEVIL's room, if you don't have enough storage space for it. See also flag 112.
flags.RUDINN_DIALOGUE_OUTCOME.descriptio: The status of your talking to Rudinn in Card Castle. Special dialogue if set to 3 but you then hurt Rudinns.
flags.TALKED_TO_HATHY.description: Whether you talked to Hathy in Card Castle. Only set if you had two or fewer Hathy kills.
flags.SUMMONED_BLUH_CHEST.description: Whether you interacted with all four Bluh Paintings, summoning the Bluh Chest.
flags.CHECKED_K_ROUND.description: Whether you Checked K. Round the first time, changing its act to Checkers (including in the second fight).
flags.SPARED_KING.description: Whether you exhausted King rather than fighting him.
flags.VIOLENT_ENDING_CH1.description: Whether you got the bad (beat people up) ending in Chapter 1. Minor dialogue differences in Castle Town.
flags.SPARED_LANCER.description: Whether you spared Lancer and Susie.
flags.THRASH_MACHINE_REMATCH_COUNT.descr: The number of times you fought Lancer and Susie, thus requiring them to blow up a Thrash Machine. Unique dialogue at 1 and 2.
flags.SHORTCUT_DOOR_HELP.description: Whether Jigsaw Joe helped restore the Warp Door. No functional change.
flags.INSPECTED_BEDS_CH1.description: Whether you inspected all four beds in Chapter 1, becoming a Bed Inspector.
flags.TRADED_TOP_CAKE.description: Whether you returned the TopCake, receiving a SpinCake in its place.
flags.TALKED_TO_STARWALKER_CH1.descripti: Whether you talked to the original Starwalker. That's foresight.
flags.RUDY_DIALOGUE_PROGRESS_CH1.descrip: Progress talking with Rudolph Holiday in Chapter 1.
flags.TALKED_TO_BERDLY_AT_HOSPITAL_WINDO: Talked to Berdly at the hospital window
Whether you talked to Berdly about visiting the hospital window to have something thrown at him. Slightly alters his dialogue about How to Draw Dragons.
flags.PUT_FINGERS_IN_PICNIC_TABLE.displa: Put fingers in the picnic table
flags.PUT_FINGERS_IN_PICNIC_TABLE.descri: Whether you tried to put your fingers in the picnic table.
flags.ONION_PLAYER_NAME.description: The name you told Onion was yours.
flags.ONION_NAME.description: The name you told Onion was theirs.
flags.BOUQUET_QUEST_PROGRESS_CH1.descrip: Progress toward failing to redeem Toriel and Asgore's relationship in Chapter 1.
flags.ASGORE_FRIDGE_EGG_STATUS.descripti: The Chapter 1 egg status, with regards to Asgore's fridge. Each stage correlates with an egg quantity in the fridge.
flags.ASGORE_STAIRS_ENTRY_X.description: Volatile. Persists the different door sides when going upstairs in Asgore's fridge via Kris's x-coordinate.
flags.TALKED_TO_CATTY_CH1.description: Whether you talked to Catty in Chapter 1.
flags.UNUSED_TORIEL_DIALOGUE_PROGRESS.de: Progress talking to Toriel in an unused variant.
flags.CALLED_TORIEL_FROM_HOME.descriptio: Whether you called Toriel's home phone, while at home. Unaccessed.
flags.TALKED_TO_ALPHYS_CH1.description: Whether you met Alphys after school in Chapter 1. Alters her dialogue the morning of Chapter 2.
flags.TALKED_TO_UNDYNE_CH1.description: Whether you met Undyne in Chapter 1.
flags.TORIEL_CALL_COUNT.description: The number of times you called Toriel after school. If zero when leaving the school, she calls you instead, incrementing the flag.
flags.SANS_DIALOGUE_PROGRESS_CH1.descrip: Progress chatting up the funny bone man in Chapter 1.
flags.SANS_PHONE_PROGRESS.description: Your progress toward being called an idiot baby.
flags.NOELLE_DIALOGUE_PROGRESS_CH1.descr: Your progress talking to Noelle outside her house in Chapter 1. If 2, she gives Susie the Light Candy in Chapter 2.
flags.HOME_RETURN_COUNT_CH1.description: The number of times you have returned home at the end of Chapter 1. Special dialogue at 0, 1, and 7; stops counting at 8.
flags.USED_RUDY_SINK_CH1.description: Whether you used the sink in Chapter 1 (of the 1&2 demo). Rudy comments on you 'loving that sink'.
flags.LOADED_LEGACY_FILE.description: Set to 1 while loading a Chapter 1 file (which has different room offsets). If 1 on an old file, you might load into a Chapter 2 room.
flags.SHADOW_CRYSTAL_USE_CH1.description: Your Shadow Crystal usage in Chapter 1. Unique dialogue if less than 2.
flags.GLASS_USE_ALONE_CH1.description: Your Glass usage without Susie around/in Chapter 1.
flags.SOLVED_DICE_BRACE_PUZZLE.descripti: Whether you solved the suits puzzle to obtain Dice Brace.
flags.FOREST_MAZE_PROGRESS.description: Volatile. Counts the number of correct rooms you've gone through in the maze. Find Susie at 4, done at 9.
flags.FOREST_MAZE_FAILURE_COUNT.descript: Volatile. Counts how much you've taken the wrong choice in the forest maze. Jumps straight to 3 (dead end) if you got lost before or found Susie.
flags.LANCER_DEAD_END_COUNT.description: The number of times you found the Lancer dead end.
flags.SUSIE_DEAD_END_COUNT.description: The number of times you found the Susie dead end.
flags.TALKED_TO_TOPCHEF_AFTER_RETURNING_: Talked to Topchef after returning the Top Cake
Whether you talked to Topchef in the pacifist end after returning the Topcake. He thinks Susie is Clover's mom.
flags.VISITED_JAIL.description: Whether you visited the jail. No effects in the Chapter 1&2 demo.
flags.HUGGED_DUMMY_CH2.description: Whether you hugged the dummy in Chapter 2. Some slight dialogue changes.
flags.KING_JAIL_DIALOGUE_PROGRESS.descri: Whether you talked to King in jail before visiting Cyber World.
flags.TOY_DELIVER_PROGRESS.description: Your progress in delivering Ralsei's first batch of subjects.
flags.BEEN_CALLED_NORMAL.description: Whether you saw Alphys and Toriel talking about you. Alters Toriel's dialogue if called.
flags.SUSIE_ATE_CAKE.description: Whether Susie ate Ralsei's entire cake (yet).
flags.TOLD_MOM_STUDYING.description: Whether you told Toriel you were going to be studying with Susie over the phone, with or without mentioning the trash orb.
flags.TOLD_MOM_ORB.displayName: Called Toriel with the trash orb
flags.TOLD_MOM_ORB.description: Whether you called Toriel while just around the corner with a trash orb on your head. Also sets flag 305.
flags.PLUSH_RECIPIENT.description: Records who you gave the plush to. In pre-1.08 versions, there's a bug resetting it to 1 before the acid river ride
flags.SAW_EGGS_HUSBAND.description: Whether you've seen Asgore make a fool of himself in public.
flags.SPAMTON_QUEST_PROGRESS.description: Your progress in learning about the power of NEO.
flags.FIRST_CHEESE_DESTROYED.description: Whether the first cheese on the left was destroyed.
flags.DESTROYED_CHEESE_ALONE.description: Whether you triggered the first cheese without Noelle, prompting slightly different text when interacting with it.
flags.TALKED_TO_SEAM_CH2.description: Set when you talk to Seam in Chapter 2, preventing them from repeating themselves.
flags.OBTAINED_SPINCAKE_CH2.description: Whether you received a fresh Spincake since Chapter 2.
flags.MR_SOCIETY_LEFT.description: Whether Mr. Society, the bishop, flew up the cliff after being talked to.
flags.SAW_SHELTER_SCENE.description: Whether Monster Kid and Snowy fled Susie at the bunker. They go home.
flags.SAW_HOSPITAL_SCENE.description: Whether Noelle went home in Chapter 2 yet (yes, either route).
flags.POLICE_SCENE_PROGRESS.description: Tracks the state of the police station dog scene.
flags.FERRIS_WHEEL_SCENE_PROGRESS.descri: Tracks progress through the Ferris wheel scene.
flags.SAW_KING_QUEEN_REUNION.description: Whether you've seen the touching reunion of King and Queen.
flags.SPAMTON_STRESS_RESPONSE.descriptio: What you said- made Kris say- after fighting Spamton NEO.
flags.RALSEI_PHOTO_STATE.description: The purty picture you took with Ralsei. Affects his title and whether he hugs Kris after Spamton NEO.
flags.ROUXLS_PIRATE_HAT.description: Whether Rouxls Kaard is currently wearing a pirate hat.
flags.SEATED_HEAD_HATHY_WITH_WEREWEREWIR: Whether you interacted with a Head Hathy or Werewerewire together at the cafe. Alters Werewerewire narration if subsequently moved away from Head Hathy.
flags.TALKED_TO_SPAMTON_ABOUT_KNIGHT.dis: Talked to Spamton about the Knight
flags.TALKED_TO_SPAMTON_ABOUT_KNIGHT.des: Whether you talked with Spamton about the Knight, changing his talk option to Friends.
flags.FOUND_TASQUE_SWITCH.description: Whether you found the switch that controls the faint hint in the Tasque maze.
flags.SAW_FERRIS_SCENE.description: Set to 1 after the Ferris wheel scene, even if skipped.
flags.FOUND_MAZE_SWITCH.description: Whether you found the old variant of the Tasque-maze switch.
flags.SOLVED_AGREE2ALL_PUZZLE.descriptio: Whether you solved the AGREE2ALL puzzle.
flags.SHOVEL_DOOR_OPEN.description: Whether you opened the door to the room filled with 999 shovels.
flags.SUSIE_AVOID_ALPHYS.description: Whether Susie is waiting due east of you rather than come close to Alphys.
flags.ALVIN_DIALOGUE_PROGRESS.descriptio: Tracks how much you talk to Alvin about his father and the hammer, and whether he mumbles to himself as you leave.
flags.FOUND_BASEMENT_SWITCH.description: Whether you activated the secret backdoor to the mansion's basement. Alter's Hacker's dialogue.
flags.FOUND_SHORTCUT_OUT.description: Whether you flipped the less-secret switch to connect the basement to the foyer. Also set on entry into the foyer on Snowgrave.
flags.SUSIE_AVOID_CATTI.description: Whether Susie has told you she isn't going into the diner (Catti's working there!)
flags.CHOCOLATE_RECIPIENT.description: Who did you give the Box of Heart-Shaped Chocolates to?
flags.MADE_HIGH_FIVE.description: Whether you pulled the lever to make a giant high-five and progress the swan ride.
flags.SOLVED_FIRST_SAUCER_PUZZLE.descrip: Looks to be set to 1 when completing the first shell game-style saucer puzzle.
flags.SAW_TOILET_STATUE.description: Whether you interacted with the Berdly statue in the toilet. Spawns the NPC outside waiting for the statue to finish in there.
flags.SOLVED_SAUCER_SHORTCUT.description: Whether you've unlocked a shortcut in Mansion by doing a saucer puzzle. I don't know which.
flags.SEEN_STATUE_COUNT.description: The number of times you interacted with the Berdly statue with Noelle with you. She has unique comments up to 8 on how obsessed you are with it.
flags.FROZEN_CHICKEN.description: Whether there is a large ice crystal you cannot see into blocking the way.
flags.FEDORA_PLUGBOY_WEREWIRED.descripti: Whether you walked far enough away for the fedora'd Plugboy to get Werewired offscreen.
flags.UNUSED_CYBER_MAZE_HINT.description: Unused flag for a hint popup in room_dw_cyber_maze_queenscreen.
